rows.label: qst650404_msg0002
rows.name:
When I thought we had to save them
quickly, I couldn't sit still...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0003
rows.name:
I think your kindness and passion
are good qualities, Hibana, but...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0004
rows.name:
You need to think about how your
actions affect things too. This time,
we lost our chance to save the kids...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0005
rows.name:
You're right... I've learned
my lesson...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0006
rows.name:
Well, you'll be fine next time,
right?

rows.label: qst650404_msg0007
rows.name:
More importantly, we need to find
the children.

rows.label: qst650404_msg0009
rows.name:
They headed toward the Lud Cloudway,
but...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0010
rows.name: I can't see them anymore, mo.

rows.label: qst650404_msg0011
rows.name: We'll just have to keep looking.

rows.label: qst650404_msg0012
rows.name: We need to find them quickly!

rows.label: qst650404_msg0013
rows.name: Ah, but keep it under control...

rows.label: qst650404_msg0014
rows.name: Are you really going to be okay?
